main_text.l: Bertu profitebatur ) fusulerunt animos : Et eum istuc quoq; ab Alberto legati de dedi-tione venissent, filius Occonis Broecmerij jam extinct VVIDSELDVS, & cum ea FOLCMARVS ALLENA Offer-hufanus[?] ad ipsum profecti se & totam illam Orientalem Frisiam, quae Comitatus nomine hodie censetur, ei tradiderunt hac lege, ut eandem in feudum ab ipso mox reciperent, fierentq; ejus beneficiarij. Hoc vero fecere, CVM FACIENDI BIVS IVS OMNINO NVLLVM HABERENT. (um his idem fecere horum exemplo animati e nobilitate quidam in agro hoc Groningano, numero sex, Ailco Onstenius Ferhildemaus, Reinerus Eisingius[?], Tamme Gockingius, Menno Honuerdaus, Omeo Snelgeri, Haijo Wibenus, quorum animi jam dudum factionum & rerum novarum studio prurierant: a quibus totum inter Lavisam & Dullartum ager velut ex aequo & bono divisus, ac Alberto datus, ab Alberto vero ipsis in feudum redditus. Quae omnia literis comprehensa signataq; sunt III Idus Septembris.

Et hi ipsi novi clientes pollicit Alberto sunt, datis ei literis, ad subigendam GRONIN-GAM, si in recusanda deditione & obseqvie ea persistaret, (nam istuc etiam legatos Albertus miserat, & optimis propositis conditionibus, ostentataq; benevolentia summa ad deditionem hortatus cives fuerat, ac si deditio fieret, obsidionem & vim denunciaverat.)

page.notes: Right margin note, beside the first lines of the text: "Pactio quaedam è nobilitate cum Alberto Bavaro, contra libertatem patriæ". Its place is marked in the text by the printed sign at the start of the note, which I did not reproduce as a reference mark. The short marks "««" beside several lines on the right (at Dullartum, ac, feudum, Quae) are printed bracket or ditto signs of the note and are not text. Doubtful readings: "Offer-hufanus" (the printed hyphen is kept), "Eisingius", "Wibenus", "Honuerdaus", the page number "75", the signature and the catchword. The "Pa&tio" in the margin is probably "Pactio" with a sign; the sign was not copied.
